'''Kavila''' was the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dalos IV]]. It was cut into the jungle of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The city was comprised of paved plazas and roads, square or pyramidal building built out of stone and [[formex]], well maintained parks, and statues based on [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] myths. A slow moving river wound its way through the center of the city.

The architecture was a mix of many styles, and was viewed as quaint by most people. The city was extremely [[Alien/Legends|alien]] friendly and [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were in the minority.
